module_summary: 16-bit two-level carry-lookahead adder: four adder_4 blocks report group Pm/Gm, and lookahead logic computes their carry-ins c4/c8/c12 plus block-level px/gx.

anchors.name: A
anchors.why: 16-bit operand A, sliced into four 4-bit chunks for the adder_4 children.

anchors.name: B
anchors.why: 16-bit operand B, sliced into four 4-bit chunks for the adder_4 children.

anchors.name: S
anchors.why: 16-bit sum concatenated from the four adder_4 F outputs.

anchors.name: c8
anchors.why: Representative lookahead carry into adder3, computed from Pm/Gm of lower blocks and c0.

anchors.name: Gm1
anchors.why: Representative group generate from adder1, feeding all higher lookahead carries and gx.

anchors.name: Pm1
anchors.why: Representative group propagate from adder1, feeding lookahead carries and px.

anchors.name: gx
anchors.why: 16-bit block generate output for a higher-level lookahead unit.

anchors.name: px
anchors.why: 16-bit block propagate output, AND of the four group propagates.

groups.name: adder_blocks
groups.description: Four 4-bit CLA adder blocks computing sum slices and group propagate/generate.

groups.name: carry_lookahead_unit
groups.description: Second-level lookahead: Pm/Gm of blocks produce carry-ins c4/c8/c12 and px/gx.
